name: io.github.zsu/data-analyst-mcp
title: US Government Data Analyst
description: U.S. government economic data (FRED, BLS, BEA, Census, Treasury and more), cited and audited.

environmentVariables.name: DATA_GOV_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free api.data.gov key (Congress.gov, FDA, FEC, GovInfo and 6 more); optional

environmentVariables.name: FRED_API_KEY

environmentVariables.name: BLS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free BLS key for higher limits and annual averages; optional

environmentVariables.name: BEA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free BEA key for the API-only datasets; optional

environmentVariables.name: CENSUS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free Census key; without it Census offers a manual download; optional
